insight: Both Ephesians 6:10–11 and Philippians 4:13 emphasize reliance on Christ's empowering strength rather than human ability. Ephesians calls believers to be strong in the Lord and His mighty power, highlighting union with Christ as the foundation for spiritual strength. Philippians similarly declares that all things can be done through Christ who continuously strengthens, focusing on divine enabling in all circumstances. Together, they underscore Christ as the source of spiritual empowerment for believers facing life's challenges.
